e: Wordplay on the idea that the person having the orgasm is saying "oh!" and their mouth is O-shaped while they're saying it. It has also sometimes been claimed that the letter o stands for the word orgasm.
q: […] right in the middle of it, he said that he loved me, and that I was perfect. And then, his O-face? Christ, man, his O-face was a horror show. Literally, the cry-baby face. I swear I could see tears each time.
